title: Hand 2: position and preceding-edge spelling alongside copying and templates
statement: For scribal hand 2, predict each word using a fitted mixture of a glyph-trigram speller, spelling conditioned on line position or the previous word's final glyph, a line-position vocabulary, page-local exact or one-glyph copying, and a prefix-core-suffix template. This tests how much predictive structure can be captured by spelling and local reuse rules without assigning meanings. Page breaks and line-position labels are supplied; the preceding-word context continues across line breaks within a page.
source: Trusted components in vs/models.py. M-001 and M-003 motivate the fixed order-3, window-50 and prefix-2/suffix-3 settings; the four registered production models did not include position_letters or boundary_letters.
